movers.text: QB Ty Dieffenbach (minor hip injury, carted off Nov. 21) is not cleared; Bob Chesney says he has a chance vs USC. Madden Iamaleava starts if he can't; Nico Iamaleava is out for the year.
QB Jaden Craig (ankle) is out on the Big 12's first availability report for Texas Tech, his 2nd straight missed game; Adam Schobel makes his 2nd start. Andy Avalos is interim coach.
Fran Brown ruled QB Steve Angeli (right AC joint, hurt Nov. 21 at BC) out for Notre Dame; Malachi Nelson, who re-aggravated his ankle late in that game, starts.
QB Conner Weigman (shoulder) missed the West Virginia win; Willie Fritz said Monday he threw and 'felt a little better', with a decision Thu/Fri. Keisean Henderson starts if not.
Cignetti won't name a QB for Purdue: Grant Wilson started vs USC and at Washington, with Josh Hoover (right shoulder since Oct. 17) relieving him in the 2nd half at Washington.

UCLA.text: QB Ty Dieffenbach (minor hip injury, carted off Nov. 21) is not cleared; Bob Chesney says he has a chance vs USC. Madden Iamaleava starts if he can't; Nico Iamaleava is out for the year.

TCU.text: QB Jaden Craig (ankle) is out on the Big 12's first availability report for Texas Tech, his 2nd straight missed game; Adam Schobel makes his 2nd start. Andy Avalos is interim coach.

Syracuse.text: Fran Brown ruled QB Steve Angeli (right AC joint, hurt Nov. 21 at BC) out for Notre Dame; Malachi Nelson, who re-aggravated his ankle late in that game, starts.

Houston.text: QB Conner Weigman (shoulder) missed the West Virginia win; Willie Fritz said Monday he threw and 'felt a little better', with a decision Thu/Fri. Keisean Henderson starts if not.

Indiana.text: Cignetti won't name a QB for Purdue: Grant Wilson started vs USC and at Washington, with Josh Hoover (right shoulder since Oct. 17) relieving him in the 2nd half at Washington.
Indiana's starting C Bray Lynch (lower leg) 'doesn't look good' for Purdue per Cignetti, and G Joe Brunner is out for the year (knee); LB Rolijah Hardy and CB A.J. Harris are also out.

Michigan State.text: QB Alessio Milivojevic (left arm) missed the Oregon loss and his Rutgers status is unclear; true freshman Kayd Coffman made his 2nd start, with backup Cam Fancher also hurt.

North Carolina.text: Bill Belichick calls QB Billy Edwards Jr. (upper body, hurt Nov. 14) a game-time decision for NC State; freshman Travis Burgess started the Nov. 21 loss at Virginia.

Clemson.text: Dabo Swinney said backup QB Christopher Vizzina (concussion) 'definitely will not be back' for South Carolina; third-stringer Trent Pearman is in line to start again.
Swinney expects LB Jeremiah Alexander back for South Carolina after missing Duke and hopes WR Tyler Brown and CB Elliot Washington II return; DT Champ Thompson is out for the season.

Ohio State.text: QB Julian Sayin (right elbow fracture) has missed every game since Oct. 17; Ryan Day said early this month he won't be back within a month. Luke Fahey starts vs Michigan.

Mississippi State.text: Starter Kamario Taylor is out for the year (Oct. 28 surgery); Lebby has not named an Egg Bowl QB between AJ Swann (hurt, missed Tennessee Tech) and Billy Puckett, who started that win.

Alabama.text: QB Keelon Russell (ankle) sat out the Chattanooga win; Kalen DeBoer said Monday he expects him back without restrictions, 'full go' all week for Auburn.

Notre Dame.text: Notre Dame ruled out S Luke Talich (Achilles, season), LB Kyngstonn Viliamu-Asa, LB Drayk Bowen and CB DJ McKinney for Syracuse; WR Jaden Greathouse (hand) is out too.

Wake Forest.text: Leading rusher Ty Clark III (591 yds, 11 TD) is out for the rest of the season, Jake Dickert said Nov. 23; Deuce Lawrence takes over vs Duke.

Kentucky.text: RB1 CJ Baxter and RT Malachi Wood (lower body, hurt at Missouri) are day-to-day and likely game-time decisions vs Louisville; Will Stein said Baxter looks the worst.

Georgia.text: Starting C Drew Bobo (back) has missed two straight games; Kirby Smart calls him day-to-day and expects him available vs Georgia Tech. Cortez Smith starts if not.

Miami.text: Mario Cristobal said Ja'Boree Antoine and Max Buchanan are back at practice, S Zechariah Poyser is expected back for Boston College and WR Malachi Toney is close to returning.

Florida State.text: Florida State's top four RBs were all out for the 28-10 loss to NC State on Nov. 21; No. 5 back Zay Parks started.

NC State.text: RB Duke Scott was hurt again in NC State's 28-10 win at Florida State on Nov. 21; Davion Gause replaced him. No status yet for the North Carolina game.

Ole Miss.text: RB Kewan Lacy is done for the season and freshman RB Shekai Mills-Knight has a high ankle sprain, per Pete Golding (Nov. 17).

Texas A&M.text: Mike Elko has not named a QB for Texas: Brady Hart started the 28-7 loss at Oklahoma after Marcel Reed was benched vs Tennessee.
